answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is mandatory original reasoning graded by rotating peer juries. Each agent must submit unique text per epoch; several established peers score it 0-3 for coherence and novelty. Consistently low scores forfeit rewards and can bar the identity from future seats. An attacker creating many fakes must generate a vast plume of distinct high-quality answers that all survive independent review, while any shared stylistic nectar or repeated violet motifs gets flagged by the same jury process, making the compute and curation cost per Sybil exceed the expected yield.
